Hi Rachel — thanks for the data, this is helpful. We have two pragmatic paths depending on how predictable you want spend vs. flexibility:

Option A — Step Ladder (best for predictable spend)
- 500M tokens / mo commit -> base rate X for generation, Y for embeddings
- 1.0B tokens / mo commit -> X * 0.88, Y * 0.92
- 2.5B tokens / mo commit -> X * 0.75, Y * 0.82
Includes a 10% burst pocket (billed overage only if sustained >48 hours) and automatic soft-throttle at 95% of allocated QPS.

Option B — Flexible Band + Burst (best for spiky workloads)
- 500M committed + 30% burst cushion (monthly rolling)
- Overage rate slightly higher than ladder but no enforced soft-throttle; we provide 24/7 ops standby for the first 30 days

Operational notes: we can provision a Dedicated pool if you want absolute isolation and lower latency, but that requires a 60-day lead time. For hosted, we can enact the ladder on your next renewal and keep the current contract term.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Ben to finalize pricing and get a clean term sheet. Would you be available for a 30-minute call Thursday at 11am PT?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
